verdicts.reason: A keeps the bottle as a clear hero, with a readable headline and CTA, and has no collisions. Flaws: the headline and buttons are left-offset and don't share an axis, the NEW badge and CTA are not aligned to each other, there is a dead gap below the bottle, and the decorative circle floats in the corner. B shrinks the bottle into a tiny corner circle that overlaps the translucent circle and touches the top and left edges. Its oversized headline dominates, the NEW and Try It pills are stacked off to the right and cramped, and a large empty area sits bottom-left. The product is lost and the layout is unbalanced.
